glosses.notes: With words, names, or text, 念 means to read or say something aloud. With people or places, especially in 念着, it means to miss them or keep thinking about them.

examples.sentence: 老师让他站起来，把最后一段大声念一遍。
孩子一边走一边念今天刚学的课文。
奶奶嘴上不说，其实一直念着在外地工作的儿子。

example_translations.translation: The teacher asked him to stand up and read the last paragraph aloud once.
The child walked along reciting the text he had just learned today.
Grandma doesn't say it, but she has been missing her son who works away from home.

glosses.notes: A person whose work and living come from farming. It refers to farmers as an occupational group, not just anyone who lives in the countryside.

examples.sentence: 天还没亮，村里的农民就已经下地干活了。
这些年，不少农民开始在网上卖自己种的水果。
对很多农民来说，今年的收成比去年更重要。

example_translations.translation: Before it was even light out, the farmers in the village had already gone to work in the fields.
In recent years, quite a few farmers have started selling the fruit they grow online.
For many farmers, this year's harvest matters more than last year's.

glosses.notes: Used when someone does something softly or without drawing attention; it can describe low-noise action or doing something without others noticing.

examples.sentence: 他悄悄走到后面坐下，谁也没注意到。
她把礼物悄悄放在门口，然后就离开了。
他把这个消息悄悄告诉我，让我先别往外说。

example_translations.translation: He quietly walked to the back and sat down, and nobody noticed.
She quietly left the gift at the door and then went away.
He told me the news in secret and asked me not to tell anyone yet.

glosses.notes: A broad everyday verb. It can mean to recognize someone or something, admit that something is true or that you were wrong, or accept someone as having a certain identity or standing.

examples.sentence: 虽然很多年没见了，我还是一下就认出了他的声音。
做错了事就要认，老找理由只会让人更生气。
大家都认他是这方面最有经验的人。

example_translations.translation: Although I hadn't seen him for many years, I still recognized his voice immediately.
If you did something wrong, you should admit it; constantly making excuses will only make people angrier.
Everyone regards him as the most experienced person in this area.

glosses.notes: A fan held and waved by hand, often used for cooling; it can also appear as a stage prop or an older everyday object.

examples.sentence: 天气太热，奶奶坐在门口慢慢摇着扇子。
那把旧扇子虽然有点破，爷爷还是一直留着。
演员上台前才发现忘了带扇子，只好临时去借。

example_translations.translation: It was so hot that Grandma sat by the doorway slowly waving a hand fan.
That old fan is a little worn, but Grandpa has still kept it all this time.
The performer only realized before going onstage that they had forgotten the fan, so they had to borrow one at the last minute.

glosses.notes: As a noun, it means an injury or wound; as a verb, often in patterns like 伤人, it means to hurt someone physically or emotionally.

examples.sentence: 他的手上还有伤，所以这几天不能碰水。
这点伤虽然不大，但是走路还是会疼。
这种话说得太重了，很容易伤人。

example_translations.translation: He still has an injury on his hand, so he can't let it touch water these next few days.
Although this injury isn't serious, it still hurts when walking.
Words said that harshly can easily hurt people.

glosses.notes: A tech verb for sending a photo, file, video, or document from a device to a website, app, platform, or online system.

examples.sentence: 报名以前，你得先把证件照片上传到系统里。
文件上传以后，组里的人都可以直接下载。
网络一直不稳定，这个视频上传了半天还没成功。

example_translations.translation: Before registering, you need to upload your ID photo to the system first.
After the file is uploaded, everyone in the group can download it directly.
The connection has been unstable the whole time, and this video still hasn't uploaded successfully after ages.

glosses.notes: Slip-on slippers, usually worn indoors, at home, in hotels, or after washing. The focus is casual indoor footwear, not regular street shoes.

examples.sentence: 回家以后，他总是先换上拖鞋再进房间。
地上刚擦过，你还是先换上拖鞋吧。
我忘了带拖鞋，只好先穿酒店准备的那双。

example_translations.translation: After coming home, he always changes into slippers before going into the room.
The floor has just been wiped, so you'd better put on slippers first.
I forgot to bring slippers, so I had to wear the pair the hotel prepared.

glosses.notes: Specifically your mother's father. This is different from 爷爷, which refers to your father's father.

examples.sentence: 外公虽然七十多了，每天还是坚持出去散步。
小时候一放暑假，我就去外公家住上两个星期。
今年过年不能回老家，我们只好先给外公打电话。

example_translations.translation: Although my maternal grandfather is already over seventy, he still keeps going out for a walk every day.
When I was little, as soon as summer vacation started, I would go stay at my maternal grandfather's home for two weeks.
We can't go back to our hometown for New Year this year, so we have to call my maternal grandfather first.

glosses.notes: A general word for a toy or plaything, especially something made for children to play with.

examples.sentence: 这个玩具不但会说话，还会跟着音乐跳舞。
弟弟每天都抱着那个玩具睡觉，谁拿走他都不高兴。
商店刚到了一批新玩具，不少家长一看见就给孩子买了。

example_translations.translation: This toy can not only talk, but also dance along with music.
My younger brother sleeps holding that toy every day, and he gets upset if anyone takes it away.
The shop has just received a batch of new toys, and many parents bought them for their children as soon as they saw them.

glosses.primary_gloss: if by any chance; in case
glosses.notes: Usually introduces an unlikely but unwanted possibility. In the fixed phrase 以防万一, it is noun-like and refers to a possible emergency or unexpected problem.

examples.sentence: 万一明天下大雨，比赛可能就要改时间。
你先把文件发给我，万一电脑出问题就麻烦了。
我还是把护照又检查了一遍，以防万一。

example_translations.translation: If it happens to rain heavily tomorrow, the game may have to be rescheduled.
Send me the file first, in case something goes wrong with the computer.
I checked my passport one more time, just in case.

glosses.notes: Usually refers to a gentle, calm smile. It can be used as a verb or as a noun.

examples.sentence: 老师一进门，就微笑着向大家问好。
她脸上的微笑让大家一下就放松了不少。
她只是微笑着点了点头，没有马上回答。

example_translations.translation: As soon as the teacher walked in, she smiled and greeted everyone.
The smile on her face made everyone relax a lot right away.
She only smiled and nodded, without answering right away.
